comments.body: should a fedora:Skolem class be added in place of the fedora:Blanknode class?

There exists such a type-- as a mixin for use internally. To Unknown's question I would say: no. The essence of our recent move to remove the publication of skolemized blank nodes was precisely the desire to stop discussing skolemized blank nodes outside the repository.

Since we have put a hold on reworking blank nodes, we have a choice here:

  1. Close this ticket as "will not fix", or
  2. Replace fedora:Blanknode with fedora:Skolem in the code and in the ontology

Thoughts, Unknown? A. Soroka?
Replace with "Skolem". "Blanknode" is flatly false and was a mistake when we did it. Those are named resources with URIs and therefore are Skolem terms, for RDF.
I agree that Skolem should be used in place of BlankNode
Does it mean that Blanknode in Unit testing should be removed?
Yinlin Chen, can you be more specific?

There are at least 3 unit testing related to Blanknode

https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/search?utf8=%E2%9C%93&q=Blanknode

Should them all be removed?
No, the tests should not be removed. The tests should be updated to expect Skolem instead.

As a part of this ticket, please update the following as well:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/ontology/blob/master/repository.rdf#L608-L614
